description: Bryan Cohn, a newly elected Democrat to the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 32, covering Granville and Vance Counties. He has served on the Oxford Board of Commissioners since 2021. Cohn's focuses on protecting reproductive rights, enhancing public education by opposing voucher programs and supporting teacher pay increases, and promoting economic prosperity through raising the minimum wage, implementing paid leave, and ensuring affordable housing
